newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Usiminas started as hold.

text.p: -- ING Barings said in a report it was initiating coverage of Brazilian steelmaker Usiminas with a hold recommendation.
-- The Dutch investment bank said the company's domestic sales are likely to be boosted by demand from state oil monopoly Petrobras and the local auto sector in 1997 and 1998.
-- The bank also said competition with CSN should be intensified in 1997, reducing the possibilities of domestic price increases.
-- Moreover, "already lean cost structure limits room for cost cuts," it added.
-- Usiminas's current investment plan targeting the auto and white line sectors should come on-stream in 1999.
-- Usiminas preferred was off 0.01 reais at 1.06 reais while its common was flat at Friday's close of 1.09 reais at 1314 local/1014 EST on the Sao Paulo bourse.
